summary: Tested current story `bootstrap-nextjs-app`. Structural acceptance criteria pass: project root contains a Next.js TypeScript App Router app (`src/app/layout.tsx`, `src/app/page.tsx`, `tsconfig.json`, `next.config.ts`), required package scripts exist (`dev`, `build`, `lint`, `test:e2e`), default home content is Customer Feedback Portal-specific, and starter boilerplate scan found no matches. Evidence: `npm run lint` passed; `npm run build` passed and prerendered `/`; script validation passed. However, the current story test design includes a Playwright functional home-route test (`FB-I1-TC-003`), and `npm run test:e2e` failed with `Error: No tests found`, so the current story test set is not fully executable.

defects.description: Playwright functional test execution for the current story fails because no executable tests exist under the configured `.ai_factory/tests/functional` test directory. Evidence: `playwright.config.ts` sets `testDir: ".ai_factory/tests/functional"`; `.ai_factory/tests/functional/feedback/iteration-1-landing-home-test-design.md` defines `FB-I1-TC-003` as a Playwright functional home-route test; running `npm run test:e2e` exited with code 1 and `Error: No tests found`.
